meta.description: Method 4: Autonomous daily certificate renewal. Runs at 02:00, checks all certs, renews those expiring within 14 days. Servers pull renewed certs at 06:00 via manage-certs.ps1 -PullOnly or manage-certs.sh pull-renew.
